title: Choose partial ReadyToRun assemblies and preserve JIT fallback
goal: Select assemblies for partial native preparation during ReadyToRun publishing when a full compilation control, excluded IL assemblies and runtime fallback must remain verifiable.

selectionNotes: Windows x64 PE route only; matched runtime and Crossgen2 packages required. No startup or throughput improvement is claimed.
SDK 10 comparison excludes whole assemblies; partial compilation is a different SDK 11 contract. IL and a JIT-capable runtime remain required.
Unprofiled partial HotRules has zero native method bodies; full control and real JIT fallback are verified. No profile-guided hot-method set is claimed.
